articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
articles.description: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

articles.title: Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID tech
articles.description: With the rise of AI agents like Instinct and Muse, the industry needs to rethink human identity on the internet and rely on biometric signals like voice, which is where Helix comes in.

articles.description: With Databricks at 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
